get.description:
Get a collection of `SLB Contract` orders.
The result set can be restricted through filter parameter.
Only `SLB Contract` orders will be returned that can be accessed by the user (security applied).
Paging is supported with parameters *limit* and *offset*.

*Get a `SLB Contract` order by ID*.
Only `SLB Contract` order will be returned that can be accessed by the user (security applied).
If user does not have access to resource, not found error will be returned instead of unauthorized - to disallow attacks.
